newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FLOWER LEADS ZIMBABWE TO COMFORTABLE WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FLOWER LEADS ZIMBABWE TO COMFORTABLE WIN.

text.p: An undefeated 95 by Andy Flower guided Zimbabwe to a comfortable 83-run victory over an Eastern Cape Invitation X1 on Wednesday.

Flower and Stuart Carlisle (52) combined in 109-run partnership for the fifth wicket to haul Zimbabwe out of trouble after they had been reduced to 61 for four by the combined side, made up of second X1 players from Eastern Province and Border provincial sides.

Flower's 116-ball innings helped Zimbabwe to 248 for six which proved far too much for the Eastern Cape side who were dismissed for 165 despite an enterprising partnership of 87 between Ashwell Prince (39) and Steve Palframan (55) for the second wicket.
The match was played at the Ntselamanzi Cricket Club on the outskirts of Alice, a black town in the former "independent" homeland of the Ciskei.
Zimbabwe are next in action on Friday when they play India in Centurion in the triangular one-day series.
